jp.name: Japanese / 日本語 — JIS, Romaji
jp.note: Requires a PC Japanese IME configured for JIS hardware and Romaji input. This does not enable the IME. Composition/candidates remain on the PC.

jp-kana.name: Japanese / 日本語 — JIS, Kana legends
jp-kana.note: Requires JIS hardware mapping and Kana input in the PC IME, not Romaji. Labels are key legends, not a prediction of composed text. Candidates remain on the PC.

ko.name: Korean / 한국어 — 2-set, 103/106-key
ko.note: PC IME: Korean 2-set with dedicated Hangul/Hanja keys. Other Korean arrangements are not inferred. Choosing this profile changes Deck labels only; activate the matching input method on the PC.

ko-104.name: Korean / 한국어 — 2-set, 101/104 Type 1
ko-104.note: PC IME: Korean 2-set, 101-key Type 1 (Right Alt = Hangul; Right Ctrl = Hanja). Other hardware types differ. Choosing this profile changes Deck labels only; activate the matching input method on the PC.

zh-pinyin.name: Chinese 简体 — Pinyin (Simplified)
zh-pinyin.note: PC IME: Simplified Chinese Pinyin. Latin key legends; no local candidate window. Choosing this profile changes Deck labels only; activate the matching input method on the PC.

zh-shuangpin.name: Chinese 简体 — Shuangpin / Double Pinyin
zh-shuangpin.note: Configure the chosen Double Pinyin scheme on the PC. Latin legends do not describe every scheme's syllable assignments. Choosing this profile changes Deck labels only; activate the matching input method on the PC.

zh-wubi86.name: Chinese 简体 — Wubi 86
zh-wubi86.note: PC IME: Wubi 86. Latin key positions only; radical/decomposition rules are handled by the PC. Choosing this profile changes Deck labels only; activate the matching input method on the PC.

zh-wubi98.name: Chinese 简体 — Wubi 98
zh-wubi98.note: PC IME: Wubi 98. Latin key positions only; this does not select or configure Wubi on the PC. Choosing this profile changes Deck labels only; activate the matching input method on the PC.

zh-wubi-new.name: Chinese 简体 — Wubi New Century
zh-wubi-new.note: PC IME: Wubi New Century. Latin key positions only; the PC handles composition and candidates. Choosing this profile changes Deck labels only; activate the matching input method on the PC.

zh-tw-zhuyin.name: Chinese 繁體 — Zhuyin / Bopomofo
zh-tw-zhuyin.note: PC IME: Traditional Chinese Zhuyin with the standard Taiwan arrangement. Alternative Zhuyin arrangements need different labels. Choosing this profile changes Deck labels only; activate the matching input method on the PC.

zh-tw-pinyin.name: Chinese 繁體 — Pinyin (Traditional)
zh-tw-pinyin.note: PC IME: Traditional Chinese Pinyin (including Taiwan users). Latin key positions; the PC controls the output script. Choosing this profile changes Deck labels only; activate the matching input method on the PC.

zh-cangjie.name: Chinese 繁體 — Cangjie / 倉頡
zh-cangjie.note: PC IME: Cangjie (Taiwan/Hong Kong/Macao). Key-root reminders only; the installed IME determines its Cangjie version and candidates. Choosing this profile changes Deck labels only; activate the matching input method on the PC.

zh-quick.name: Chinese 繁體 — Quick / 速成
zh-quick.note: PC IME: Quick/Sucheng (Taiwan/Hong Kong/Macao). Shares Cangjie key roots; completion is entirely on the PC. Choosing this profile changes Deck labels only; activate the matching input method on the PC.

zh-jyutping.name: Chinese 繁體 — Cantonese Jyutping
zh-jyutping.note: Requires a PC IME supporting Jyutping. Latin legends only; DeckThere does not install or configure a Cantonese IME. Choosing this profile changes Deck labels only; activate the matching input method on the PC.
